semanticRevisions.summary: One final system: populated state and replay survive process restart and repeated initialization, with no intermediate V1 binary/database.
Published correctness under bounded concurrent ingest/quota/recovery, not an unpublished throughput, latency or recovery-time score.
Literal-template strict input and immutable rendering; only published Notification item route. No hidden template grammar or invented Notification collection route.
Retain actual HMAC verification using newly public NOTIFYROUTE_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET and X-NotifyRoute-Signature.
Durable queued fan-out/control and process replacement are observable; no claim to force unpublished private lease barrier phases.
